For the explicitly defined class-function SU(2) one-plaquette Jacobi Hamiltonian with alpha=1,beta=1/2, min-max and a complete infinite-representation-tail quadratic-form estimate give E1-E0 >= 3/2 - sqrt(21/20)/2 > 79/80. This does not establish a 4D continuum physical mass gap or novelty.

claims.statement: For N noninteracting SU(2) single-plaquette copies with rank-one all-trivial-character P0, the norm of (I-P0) H_N P0 is beta sqrt(N), while the decoupled Hamiltonian's first gap is independent of N. Thus that global coupling norm is not automatically volume-uniform.

claims.statement: A local, gauge-invariant, scale-adaptive high-representation tail estimate could in principle control physical infrared correlations through interacting Wilson-lattice limits. Need explicit two-plaquette Gauss-law calculation, source-verified Wigner-6j matrix elements, and countertests at varying coupling and size.
